verdict.line: You lose lane trades and all-ins before level 6, but Camille's 51.7% head-to-head over 646 games comes from out-scaling Illaoi once Trinity Force completes.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit) forces a binary choice every 16/15/14/13/12s: stand and fight the spirit while it mirrors a percentage of the damage you deal back onto you, or run and become a Vessel that spawns Tentacles for her passive to farm off of. Either answer favors her, which is why OP.GG marks lane and solo-kill advantage in her favor despite the overall matchup being close. Camille has no tool to interrupt E or clear Tentacles from range, so she has to win the matchup on cooldown-reading and scaling rather than raw dueling.

theirWindow.when: She lands W near standing Tentacles
theirWindow.what: Harsh Lesson (W, 4s cooldown) leaps her to you and makes nearby Tentacles swing at you too, healing her off every hit. Back off and let the wave push if you see Tentacles up near a wall.

yourWindow.when: Her W and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without Harsh Lesson or Test of Spirit up she has no leap and no mirror-damage threat, so this is when Q (Precision Protocol) auto-trades are actually even. Walk up, take the trade, walk back out before W is back up.

start.why: The 51.9% win rate over 572 games reflects what you need here: raw HP and sustain to survive repeated Harsh Lesson pokes without a reliable way to punish them back.

boots.why: 54.6% win rate over 515 games. Illaoi's damage is entirely physical — her W, her Tentacles, and her R — so flat physical reduction blunts every one of her tools, not just autos.

core.why: The spell-blade proc off Q (Precision Protocol) is what finally lets you out-trade her once it's online; this is the item that explains the 11-15 power spike.
Gives you the sustain to survive extended Tentacle uptime in side-lane skirmishes once teamfights start involving her Vessels.
57.4% win rate over 162 games for this exact path. The damage-over-time conversion is what keeps you alive through a Harsh Lesson plus Tentacle stack-up instead of dying to the burst.

situational.when: she is healing off tentacle hits and her own W faster than you can out-damage her
you are ahead and need to survive a committed all-in near her wall-spawned tentacles
you are snowballing and want faster Q and E cooldowns to keep pressuring before she can reset with tentacles

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp's proc-and-heal on an auto trade is the only thing giving you sustained HP back in a lane where you can't contest Test of Spirit cleanly; it directly offsets the chip damage from Harsh Lesson and Tentacle swings.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 67% of games at a 51.9% win rate and gives you a way to disengage Test of Spirit or punish an overextended all-in with the Grievous Wounds she needs countered. If you expect a longer siege-style lane, Teleport+Ignite posts the highest win rate in the data at 59.3% over a smaller 16.1% of games.

playing.title: Clear tentacles before any commitment
playing.detail: Per OP.GG's own read on this matchup, kill standing Tentacles near walls before you trade or use E (Hookshot) to engage — they will keep swinging and healing her through the entire exchange otherwise.

playing.title: Run from Test of Spirit when losing
playing.detail: If she lands E (Test of Spirit) and you can't win the damage-mirror trade, disengage immediately rather than standing in it — becoming a Vessel means you spawn Tentacles that extend her advantage for the rest of the fight.

playing.title: Trade only when W is down
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson is only a 4-second cooldown at all ranks, so you cannot out-trade her on a timer the way you would against a normal bruiser — wait for the moment right after she uses it before walking up.

playing.title: Save E for repositioning, not opening
playing.detail: Hookshot (E, 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown) needs a nearby wall and only knocks up on landing, so it's a punish tool for catching her out of position, not a safe way to open a trade into her W threat range.

playing.title: Buy into her healing, not around it
playing.detail: Executioner's Calling matters more here than usual — her passive Tentacles heal her on every champion hit, so Grievous Wounds removes a real chunk of her lane sustain, not just a marginal one.

playing.title: Track her ultimate cooldown
playing.detail: Leap of Faith drops from 120s to 70s at rank 3, spawning a Tentacle per champion it hits — don't isolate yourself or a teammate near her once she's level 11+.

playing.title: Survive to your spike, don't force it
playing.detail: This is a defensive lane by design; your job before level 11 is staying even on CS and HP, not finding kills, because the win condition lives in the 11-15 Trinity Force window.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample-size figures above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why each trade and timing window exists — is this brief's own tactical analysis.
